description: This file implements an API endpoint in PHP that handles device requests for an 'EasyConnect' feature, manages security tokens, and processes configuration data related to WiFi access points and DPP (Device Provisioning Protocol). It includes functions for token generation, validation, and request processing, as well as handling of public key management and MAC address validation.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a key used for encrypting tokens, involving file system checks and external commands.

methods.name: genToken
methods.description: Creates an encrypted token with expiration time, utilizing AES-128-CBC encryption and a secret key.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Decrypts and verifies the provided token, confirming it is within its valid time window.

methods.name: processPostRequest
methods.description: Processes incoming POST requests related to DPP URI, extracts relevant parameters, and updates device configuration via setStr.

methods.name: authenticateCaller
methods.description: Performs authentication for incoming requests, either via tokens or challenge-response, and calls token generation if needed.
